crossRefs.note: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
It shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write himself a copy of this law in a book, out…
It shall be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear Yahweh his God, to…
Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and to…
He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children…
